thread:
Irene: Quick pass on the dark console iteration — two separate bits: code block syntax colors look washed on the deep-slate background, and chart stacked-area colors clash with the new alert red when overlaid. Posting frames: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/dark-console-v4 (frames: 'Code - Dark', 'Metrics - Stacked').

Liam: Screenshot pls? Also which browser/device? I noticed the syntax highlight issue on macOS Chrome.

Irene: macOS Chrome. Screenshot attached in Figma. Current tokens for code: 

```css
--bg: #07101a;
--panel: #0c1622;
--code-bg: #071420;
--syntax-keyword: #9fb7ff; /* pale blue */
--syntax-fn: #b4f6c1; /* mint */
--syntax-string: #ffd5a1; /* warm */
--code-line-number: #2a3846;
```

Diego: The keyword blue is low saturation -> on dark it loses warmth and looks greyish. Recommend nudging hue towards slightly more saturated cyan: '#7ec7ff' (improves pop without being neon). Also increase function name weight color to '#9ef0b7'.

Priya: For strings, warm yellow at small sizes can be hard to read. Consider '#ffcf78' -> more contrast. Also ensure inline code contrast with surrounding bg meets 4.5:1.

ThemeBot: Accessibility scan results: syntax-keyword #9fb7ff on code-bg #071420 = 3.6:1 (FAIL for body-size). syntax-string #ffd5a1 on code-bg = 3.3:1 (FAIL). Suggested replacements: keyword -> #7ec7ff, string -> #ffcf78.

Liam: For charts — stacked-area uses ['#3fb1ff', '#6be08b', '#ffd27a', '#ff9180'] but alert/red is '#ff5c4d' and overlaps with the fourth series. We need perceptual separation when overlaid with alert. Suggestions: either move fourth series to purple-ish '#caa0ff' or darken red to '#e64b3e' for alerts.

Diego: Also legend text color on panel is #aab6c4 which is ok, but selected legend pill uses the same background as panel -> low contrast. Add an inset border or slight glow: 'box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.04) inset' or change selected bg to '#122632'.

Priya: Tiny copy nit for the theme toggle. Current copy: 'Dark theme'. Suggest: 'Enable dark theme' and aria-label='Enable dark theme, toggles between light and dark' to clarify in i18n. Also we should preserve user preference in localStorage + account setting.

Irene: Good. What about a keyboard-accessible switch — when focused, the track color should change enough to be discoverable: propose '--focus-ring: rgba(120,200,255,0.2)' and a 2px solid fallback for UA that doesn't support box-shadow.

ThemeBot: Contrast check for suggested chart swatches on panel #0c1622: '#3fb1ff' = 4.7:1, '#6be08b' = 4.5:1, '#ffd27a' = 3.8:1 (borderline), '#caa0ff' = 4.2:1. If you keep '#ffd27a', use thicker stroke or larger area to improve visibility. Also flag: stacked area overlap may create mid-tones that drop contrast. Consider using semi-transparent overlays with compositing-mode 'lighter' to keep edges visible.

Liam: Implementation notes: we'll expose CSS tokens and a chart-palette array. Recharts/vis can accept hex + opacity. Example: `const palette = [{color:'#3fb1ff'},{color:'#6be08b'},{color:'#ffd27a',opacity:0.9},{color:'#caa0ff'}];` We'll add legend border change and aria descriptions for charts.

Diego: One accessibility suggestion: add an alternative colorblind-safe palette (Viridis-like) toggle for metrics-heavy dashboards. Proposal: ['#440154','#3b528b','#21918c','#5ec962','#fde725'] as opt-in.

Priya: That viridis ramp is great for colorblind folks but note the last yellow on dark might be too bright; clamp the luminance a bit. I'll add Figma variants.

Irene: Action list: @Liam - PR with token updates + legend pill focus style; @Diego - add viridis variant behind feature flag; @Priya - update Figma and i18n copy for toggles. I'll run a staging pass after the PR.

Liam: I'll have a draft PR with updated tokens and unit test for the code contrast util by EOD.

Priya: Figma updated and comments added.

ThemeBot: Re-scan pending changes when PR lands.

Irene: Thanks all — this feels much more readable. We'll validate on high-dpi screens too. :sparkles:
